new_rules.inn_and_suites: 'Comfort Inn & Suites Fishers' and 'Comfort Inn Fishers' are one hotel. The token is dropped ONLY when it directly follows 'inn', so 'Comfort Suites South' keeps its 'suites' and stays a different brand from 'Comfort Inn South'.
new_rules.token_order: Google writes 'Avon Indianapolis' where the census writes 'Indianapolis Avon'. Compared as sorted tokens: exact multiset equality, so one extra or one missing word is still two hotels.
new_rules.no_fuzzy_matching: no edit distance, no similarity score, no overlap threshold
